summary: Tested notification system for Mathmate chat. All 6 features verified and working correctly. Backend APIs (GET /api/messages/unread/count, POST /api/messages/{connection_id}/mark-read) pass 10/10 tests. Frontend notification badge displays correctly with pulsing animation when unread_count > 0, and disappears when messages are read. Background task for 24-hour email notification is running.
seed_data_creation: Created test user 'Badge Test User' with connection to admin for notification badge testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Notification system fully tested. GET /api/messages/unread/count returns unread_count and connections_with_unread details. Navigation.jsx polls every 30 seconds and displays red pulsing badge on Mathmate nav link when unread_count > 0. Messages are marked as read when GET /messages/{connection_id} is called (viewing chat). Background task runs hourly to check for messages older than 24 hours and sends email notifications.

navigation_notification_badge.details: Badge displays on Mathmate nav link with data-testid='mathmate-notification-badge'. Shows count (or 99+ for >99). Has pulsing animation (animate-pulse class) and red/pink gradient styling.

badge_disappears_on_read.details: Badge correctly disappears when user clicks on a chat conversation and views messages. GET /messages/{connection_id} automatically marks messages as read.

polling_every_30_seconds.details: Navigation.jsx line 42: setInterval(fetchUnreadCount, 30000). Polling starts on login and clears on logout.

background_email_notification_task.details: scheduled_notification_checker() runs hourly (asyncio.sleep(3600)). Checks for unread messages older than 24 hours and sends email via SendGrid. Task startup confirmed in backend logs: 'Started scheduled notification checker background task'

endpoints_verified: GET /api/messages/unread/count - Returns unread count and connection details
POST /api/messages/{connection_id} - Send message creates unread for receiver
GET /api/messages/{connection_id} - Viewing messages marks them as read
GET /api/connections - Returns connections with unread_count per connection

pages_tested: Homepage - Notification badge visible on Mathmate nav link when unread_count > 0
Mathmate page - Chat list shows unread indicator per connection
Chat conversation - Messages displayed, reading clears unread

design_review.notification_badge_styling: Red/pink gradient (from-red-500 to-pink-500) with pulsing animation, shadow effect (shadow-red-500/50), proper positioning (absolute -top-2 -right-4)
design_review.accessibility: Badge text is clearly visible (white text on colored background, font-bold)
